description: Approved Windows technical configuration checks for the SecureAudit MVP.

checks.name: Windows Firewall Enabled
checks.description: Checks whether all applicable Windows Firewall profiles are enabled.
checks.expected_value: All applicable Windows Firewall profiles are enabled
checks.mapping_note: This check verifies firewall enablement only and does not validate every requirement of the broader safeguard.
checks.remediation: Enable the Domain, Private, and Public Windows Firewall profiles through Windows Security, Group Policy, or an approved administrative configuration method.

checks.name: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Active
checks.description: Checks whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus is installed and reports antivirus protection as enabled.
checks.expected_value: Microsoft Defender Antivirus protection is enabled
checks.mapping_note: The technical check is included in the MVP, but its exact CIS Controls safeguard mapping will be validated before the reporting feature is finalized.
checks.remediation: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus or confirm that an approved third-party antivirus product is intentionally managing endpoint protection.

checks.name: BitLocker Protection Active
checks.description: Checks whether BitLocker protection is active on the operating-system drive.
checks.expected_value: BitLocker protection is active on the operating-system drive
checks.mapping_note: The technical check is included in the MVP, but its exact CIS Controls safeguard mapping will be validated before the reporting feature is finalized.
checks.remediation: Enable BitLocker on the operating-system drive and securely back up the recovery key using an approved organizational process.

checks.name: Guest Account Disabled
checks.description: Checks whether the built-in Windows Guest account is disabled.
checks.expected_value: The built-in Guest account is disabled
checks.mapping_note: The technical check is included in the MVP, but its exact CIS Controls safeguard mapping will be validated before the reporting feature is finalized.
checks.remediation: Disable the built-in Guest account through Local Users and Groups, PowerShell, or an approved Group Policy configuration.

checks.name: SMBv1 Disabled
checks.description: Checks whether the legacy SMBv1 protocol is disabled.
checks.mapping_note: The technical check is included in the MVP, but its exact CIS Controls safeguard mapping will be validated before the reporting feature is finalized.
checks.remediation: Disable the SMB 1.0/CIFS feature unless a documented and approved legacy dependency requires it.
